body.objective: Extend finite series and resonant normal forms to typed asymptotic scales, logarithmic/generalized modes, WKB sectors and matched expansions. This is required to decide whether repeated fourth-order roots yield bounded metric modes, logarithmic partners or secular growth, and to prevent Conflux from treating formal series around different endpoints or scales as comparable solutions.
body.stop_condition: Provide ordered asymptotic scales, valuations and dominance; Laurent, Puiseux and logarithmic transseries; Frobenius/Jordan chains; exponential/WKB sectors; exact coefficient recurrences; residual-order certificates; overlap domains and matched inner/outer expansions; Stokes-ray and connection-matrix metadata; and Borel transform/summability labels where certified, otherwise FORMAL_ONLY. Demonstrate on a repeated-root fourth-order scalar control and the axial Schwarzschild radial system: construct all formal endpoint families, reconstruct metric variables from the curvature carrier, identify polynomial/logarithmic partners, match one overlap with a validated residual bound, and reject a mutation that changes geometric multiplicity. Export each expansion with endpoint, scale, sector, truncation error status and relation to the exact operator for Conflux.
body.forbid: no formal series called convergent or asymptotic without a bound; no curvature-carrier falloff silently assigned to the reconstructed metric; no repeated characteristic treated as two ordinary eigenmodes without a Jordan check; no terms from different asymptotic scales compared by coefficient alone; no WKB branch or Stokes multiplier chosen without path/sector metadata; no physics radial equation hard-coded into lib/math
notes: Priority B and a direct Paper-14 gate.
Compose with laurent, series, spectral/Jordan, validated ODE and complex analytic continuation.
Formal classification may land before rigorous matching, but the lifecycle boundary must remain explicit.
